question: How is the Goddess associated with the power and ritual seat of musk?
premises: She is the abode of the power of musk.
She has gone to the pit of the power of musk.
inference: The Goddess embodies and occupies the sacred locus of musk's power.
uncertainties: kuṇḍa may refer to a ritual fire-pit or a sacred basin; rendered as pit.
plain_english: She is the abode of the power of musk and has gone to the pit of the power of musk.
